_comment: Overlay en-US (US-203) — só kicker/blurb de races/classes/subclasses. Sem `name`: o rótulo EN já vem de graça do `name` do dataset (resolve() cai nele quando o overlay não tem `name`). Sem lugar aqui para attributes/skills/features/spells/backgrounds/tools/etc — esses domínios são nativamente EN no dataset, sem curadoria própria. Mesma disciplina de herança da pt-BR.json: subespécie repete o blurb da raiz, sobrescreve só o kicker.

dragonborn.blurb: Draconic blood on full display: scales, an elemental breath, and a reputation that arrives before you do.

dwarf.blurb: Built to last: resistant to poison, sees in the dark of the mine, and carries clan pride into every decision.

elf.blurb: Doesn't need real sleep, sees in the dark, and moves with an elegance few peoples can match.

gnome.blurb: Small, sharp, and immune to most magic that meddles with the mind — their curiosity has caused more trouble (and more solutions) than you'd expect.

half-elf.blurb: Neither fully human nor fully elven, and uses that in-between status to talk their way into almost any room.

half-orc.blurb: Inherited the orcish blood's stamina and muscle — falls, gets back up, and keeps swinging until the fight is over.

halfling.blurb: Short, quick, and oddly hard to hit — luck seems to favor whoever knows how to duck behind anything bigger than they are.

high-elf.blurb: Doesn't need real sleep, sees in the dark, and moves with an elegance few peoples can match.

hill-dwarf.blurb: Built to last: resistant to poison, sees in the dark of the mine, and carries clan pride into every decision.

human.blurb: No racial trick at all — just adaptability, ambition, and the ability to become nearly anything they decide to be.

lightfoot.blurb: Short, quick, and oddly hard to hit — luck seems to favor whoever knows how to duck behind anything bigger than they are.

rock-gnome.blurb: Small, sharp, and immune to most magic that meddles with the mind — their curiosity has caused more trouble (and more solutions) than you'd expect.

tiefling.blurb: Carries horns, a tail, and a slice of infernal heritage that unsettles strangers — plus fire resistance that saves their skin more than once.

barbarian.blurb: Charges into the front line and hits harder the worse things get. Short on words, long on raw physical presence.

bard.kicker: A word that cuts and heals
bard.blurb: A double-edged blade of music, lore, and easy confidence: inspires allies, talks enemies in circles, and knows a little about almost everything.

cleric.kicker: Faith with a blade in hand
cleric.blurb: Carries their god's healing and wrath onto the battlefield — prays little, acts constantly, and the party survives because of it.

druid.blurb: Becomes a bear, a wolf, or a bird when a human shape isn't enough, and calls the wind and the earth to fight alongside them.

fighter.blurb: No magic, no tricks — just discipline, steel, and reflex. Survives and dominates any melee through sheer mastery of the craft.

marshal.blurb: Leads from inside the brawl: every shouted order buys an ally an extra strike or one more breath to keep standing.

monk.kicker: The body as the only weapon
monk.blurb: Strikes too fast for the eye to follow, walks on water, and slips out of restraints — all trained, none of it borrowed from magic.

paladin.blurb: A sacred vow becomes light in their hands: heals whoever falls beside them, and burns whoever dares stand in the way.

ranger.blurb: Tracks any prey through any wilderness, fights alongside an animal companion, and never gets lost where others would.

rogue.kicker: A clean strike, a cleaner exit
rogue.blurb: Shows up where no one expects, hits the weak point before anyone notices, and vanishes before the response comes.

sorcerer.blurb: Never studied a single spell — born with the power in their veins, and bends every spell to their will when the normal rules don't apply.

warlock.blurb: Struck a pact with something greater than themselves, and now casts borrowed spells whose true price only they understand.

wizard.blurb: Studied every arcane formula into a spellbook, and has a magical answer ready for nearly any problem the party runs into.

champion.blurb: Fewer tricks, more sharpened steel: lands critical hits more often and is decent at nearly anything physical.

circle-of-the-land.blurb: Guardian of one specific biome, with extra spells tied to it and a personal pool of magic that refills partway through the day.

college-of-lore.blurb: Collects secrets and spells from other classes, and uses a sharp word to wreck an enemy's defenses at just the right moment.

draconic-bloodline.blurb: A dragon ancestor left its mark: tougher skin, an affinity for one type of elemental damage, and spells that feel grander for it.

gambling-general.blurb: Every tier is a gamble: take a penalty to hit for more damage, or trade safety for advantage. Leads troops willing to give ground to win the round.

hunter.blurb: A specialist at taking down one specific threat: picks tactics against groups, against big creatures, or against a single dangerous target.

life-domain.blurb: The healer's cleric, through and through: every healing spell comes back bigger, and keeps the party standing through the worst of it.

oath-of-devotion.blurb: The most classic oath: protects the weak, punishes evil, and never breaks their word, even when it costs them dearly.

path-of-the-berserker.blurb: Rage without limits: attacks more times per round and shrugs off fear while the rage lasts, at the cost of exhaustion once it fades.

school-of-evocation.blurb: A specialist in controlled destruction: shapes their own spells to spare allies caught in the blast, and deals more damage for it.

swift-strategist.blurb: Pushes the squad forward on speed: extra movement, disengage without provoking, escape from area effects. No one in your unit gets caught standing still.

talented-tactician.blurb: Backs the party with a tactics die that boosts any ally's attack, plus quiet coordination and field expertise. Steady advantage, no bets placed.

the-fiend.blurb: Struck a pact with something from the infernal planes: stronger fire spells and a burst of extra hit points on dropping an enemy.

thief.blurb: The nimblest-handed rogue: climbs, balances, and uses magic items faster than any other class in the game.

way-of-the-open-hand.blurb: The most versatile unarmed fighting style: every strike can knock down, push back, or stun, with no extra resource spent.
